name: ImageShearDrawingAxis
syntax: ImageShearDrawingAxis( any image, number shx, number shy )

params.name: image
params.description: The image on which this operation is performed.

params.name: shx
params.description: The multiplier by which coordinates are shifted in the positive x axis direction as a function of the y coordinate.

params.name: shy
params.description: the multiplier by which coordinates are shifted in the positive y axis direction as a function of the x coordinate.
